Question: Let \(ABCD\) be a square. Let \(E,\) \(F,\) \(G,\) and \(H\) be the centers, respectively, of equilateral triangles with bases \(\overline{AB},\) \(\overline{BC},\) \(\overline{CD},\) and \(\overline{DA},\) each exterior to the square. What is the ratio of the area of square \(EFGH\) to the area of square \(ABCD?\)
